caseNameFull: Scott, aka Plummer v. Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Edward Q. Carr, Jr., for petitioner. Solicitor General Marshall for respondent.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Case transferred to appellate docket and set for oral argument immediately following No. 898.
